title: Perfect Symmetry
description: This Resource pack makes EVERYTHING symmetrical.
body:
This resource pack makes EVERYTHING symmetrical in minecraft.

I used code to take every texture file, get the top left corner, and flip it around the other 3 corners. Although every texture is technically perfectly symmetrical, some of them still have problems which I need to manually fix later.

This affects animations, blocks, items, entities, and everything other than the font, since that made it too hard to read.

This is by no means practical, but it sure is fun.

Showcase vid: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WgIklApOFZI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WgIklApOFZI)
